review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting review by a Latinist. House style: simple Church Latin, spelled without macrons, with u/v and i/j as in Stage 0 (v and i only); present tense, with a few perfects (venit, vidit, fuit, dixit) in the last units.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Heri Anna et Lucius ad mare venerunt. Samuel et Marcus quoque venerunt.
sentences.english: Yesterday Anna and Lucius came to the sea. Samuel and Marcus came too.

sentences.text: Mare non longe est. Postquam ad litus venerunt, mare viderunt.
sentences.english: The sea is not far. After they came to the shore, they saw the sea.

sentences.text: Ecce mare! Ecce aqua magna!
sentences.english: Look, the sea! Look, the big water!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Mare est. Ecce litus. Hic ambulamus.
sentences.english: It is the sea. Look, the shore. Here we walk.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Quid est hoc in aqua? Estne insula?
sentences.english: What is this in the water? Is it an island?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Insula est, et longe est. Ecce, navis ad insulam it!
sentences.english: It is an island, and it is far away. Look, a ship goes to the island!
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Navem video! Navis magna est. In nave multi homines sunt.
sentences.english: I see the ship! The ship is big. In the ship there are many people.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Homines ad insulam eunt. Ibi habitant.
sentences.english: The people go to the island. They live there.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Marcus in litore sedet. Aquam videt. Piscem in aqua videt.
sentences.english: Marcus sits on the shore. He sees the water. He sees a fish in the water.

sentences.text: Ecce piscis! Piscem in aqua video!
sentences.english: Look, a fish! I see a fish in the water!
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Ubi est? Non video.
sentences.english: Where is it? I do not see it.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ibi est! Statim video. Sed nunc piscis in aqua non est.
sentences.english: It is there! I see it at once. But now the fish is not in the water.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Piscis aquam amat. Ego aquam amo.
sentences.english: The fish loves the water. I love water.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Anna panem et pomum in litore parat, et omnes edunt et bibunt.
sentences.english: Anna prepares bread and fruit on the shore, and all eat and drink.

sentences.text: Lucius dixit: Heri in schola fui. Hodie in schola non sum. Hodie hic sum. Bene est!
sentences.english: Lucius said: Yesterday I was at school. Today I am not at school. Today I am here. It is well!

sentences.text: Samuel dixit: Dies bonus est. Gratias Deo ago.
sentences.english: Samuel said: It is a good day. I give thanks to God.

sentences.text: Post cenam ad urbem eunt. Marcus iterum aquam videt.
sentences.english: After the meal they go to the town. Marcus looks at the water again.

sentences.text: Cras iterum ad mare venimus?
sentences.english: Do we come to the sea again tomorrow?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Cras non venimus. Cras in valetudinario laboro.
sentences.english: Tomorrow we do not come. Tomorrow I work at the clinic.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Cras in schola sum. Sed dies Dominica venimus.
sentences.english: Tomorrow I am at school. But on Sunday we come.
sentences.speaker: luis

sentences.text: Bene! Dies Dominica iterum venimus.
sentences.english: Good! On Sunday we come again.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Gratias vobis ago, amici. Hodie dies bonus fuit. Pax vobis!
sentences.english: Thank you, friends. Today was a good day. Peace to you!
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Canis quoque ad litus venit. Marcus canem amat. Canis aquam amat, et in aqua ambulat.
sentences.english: The dog comes to the shore too. Marcus loves the dog. The dog loves water, and walks in the water.

sentences.text: Anna et Samuel ad montem ambulant. Ex monte mare vident, et insulam vident. Avis in arbore cantat.
sentences.english: Anna and Samuel walk to the hill. From the hill they see the sea, and they see the island. A bird sings in the tree.
